prompt: A gaunt hooded specter in tattered black-violet funeral shrouds hovers over a terrified peasant who has fallen onto his back, the specters skeletal hand plunged into the victims forehead and dragging out a fan of glowing parchment playing cards that dissolve into pale violet wisps. The specter floats just off the ground, shroud trailing like smoke. The only light is the cold violet glow of the stolen cards. The background is a fog-choked moonlit graveyard with leaning headstones.
